description: Ministry of Industry & Commerce - Consumer Affairs Authority Act. No. 09 of 2003 order under section 20(5)
categorisation: This gazette content contains a regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes maximum retail prices for different varieties of rice, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
